proposal.reason: Primary change is copy-engine behavior: CE/ltOki ring isolation, reserved CE stream/ring hinting, OKI enablement gating across ranks, and OKI QP/ring mapping updates to prevent mixed CE/OKI hangs. Symmetric is additionally required because device-side symmetric OKI kernels and helpers change AR/RS tail sizing, broadcast pre-clamping, and lane/slice splitting logic, which are substantive correctness fixes in symmetric collective execution.
